newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-BESIKTAS PLAYERS TO GET VILLAS IF CHAMPIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BESIKTAS PLAYERS TO GET VILLAS IF CHAMPIONS.

text.p: Players of Istanbul club Besiktas will each be given a villa if they win the Turkish league championship, a club administrator was quoted on Tuesday as saying.
"This year we will be champions, 100 percent. When we are champions I'll give all the footballers a villa," Erdal Acar said in an interview with the sports paper Fanatik.

Acar said he had already donated 100 billion Turkish lira ($875,000) to Besiktas, the club he has supported since boyhood. He said he had once been stabbed by rival Fenerbahce fans for supporting Besiktas.
"I am ready to do everything for Besiktas's success. In life my son comes first, then Besiktas," he said.
Besiktas are fourth in the table with 38 points, seven points behind leaders Galatasaray.
